subject: Helios Cloud — vendor privacy docs, DPA & PO path
messages:
From: Amrita Singh <amrita@helioscloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioscloud.com
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list and PO steps

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — Helios is interested in moving Redwood into our procurement queue. Legal asked me to kick off the paperwork: can you send over
  - our DPA / standard contractual clauses (if applicable)
  - a pointer to your latest SOC 2 report (or a secure link)
  - an up-to-date subprocessor roster (CSV or PDF)
  - billing instructions and preferred PO/invoice flow (who to send PO to, remit-to, and whether DocuSign is preferred for signature)

We also have a simple PO template attached for your team to review (we'd like to include SLA language if it's available). If there are any export controls or data residency constraints we should flag them now, please call them out.

Preferred timeline: procurement wants everything in the queue by May 10 so they can cut a PO before the end of month.

Thanks — copying procurement.

Amrita Singh
Procurement Lead
Helios Cloud
[Attachment: helios_po_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Amrita Singh <amrita@helioscloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list and PO steps

Hi Amrita — appreciate the clear ask and the PO template. Quick confirmation: we'll get the DPA, SOC 2 link, and an exported subprocessor list over to you today.

Attached for initial review:
  - DPA_Redwood_v1.pdf (our standard DPA; editable for enterprise redlines)
  - subprocessor_list_202705.pdf (current as of May 2027)

SOC 2: we host a secure SOC 2 report on our portal; link below (short-lived access).

Billing & PO: Laura (cc'd) handles billing and invoicing. Laura — can you confirm the remit-to address and whether Helios requires Net30 on their PO? Also: do we need to route this through finance for a one-time merchant onboarding form?

Amrita — for signature we typically send a DocuSign envelope containing the DPA + SOW (if any). If Helios prefers a redline instead of DocuSign sign-off, let us know. Otherwise we'll prepare the envelope against the attached PO template.

Related links:
  - SOC 2 (secure): https://redwood-inference.com/reports/soc2/latest
  - Drive folder (onboarding evidence): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Helios-Onboard

I'll follow up with a DocuSign link once Laura confirms billing details.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DPA_Redwood_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: subprocessor_list_202705.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Amrita Singh <amrita@helioscloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioscloud.com
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list and PO steps

Thanks Jonas — that helps. A couple of follow-ups from Legal/InfoSec:
  1) Can you provide the subprocessor list as a CSV (our legal team ingests it into their tracker)? PDF is fine for now but CSV is preferred.
  2) Our security team asked about key management: is customer data encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS) or provider-managed keys? If provider-managed, what controls/backups are in place?
  3) We attached the Helios PO template (blank) — please confirm whether Redwood needs an executed DPA prior to issuing a PO or if the PO can be issued now with DPA in parallel.

Procurement note: we cut POs through our portal. For payments we need the remit-to (for invoice). Can you confirm invoice email and legal entity name?

I've attached the PO template for your reference.

Amrita
[Attachment: helios_po_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Amrita Singh <amrita@helioscloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC2 link, subprocessor list and PO steps

Amrita — thanks, marking items and owners below so procurement can proceed:

  - Subprocessor CSV: I'll ask Security to export and send as CSV by EOD Tuesday (Rishi is on it).
  - KMS: Redwood currently uses provider-managed keys for hosted offering; we offer customer-managed keys on Dedicated and Private deployments. I'll paste a short note from Security in the onboarding Drive folder.
  - Executed DPA vs PO: We can accept the PO now and run DPA signature in parallel. If Helios needs the executed DPA before provisioning, please tell us and we'll prioritize signature.

Laura, can you confirm remit-to details and whether Redwood needs a supplier form for Helios? Laura will also invoice under: Redwood Inference, Inc. — remit-to billing@redwood-inference.com — Tax ID: 12-3456789.

Next steps (owned):
  - Rishi M. (security) to upload subprocessor CSV to the Drive folder and add KMS note (by 2027-05-11).
  - Jonas to send DocuSign envelope for DPA if Helios prefers signed copy (will include DPA + simple SOW placeholder).
  - Laura to confirm remit-to and invoice process (today).

DocuSign envelope (pending): https://docusign.net/envelope/ABC123def456
HubSpot deal: HS-23891
Onboarding folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Helios-Onboard

If procurement wants us to snapshot SOC 2 to their portal we can provide a one-time export; otherwise the secure link above will be sufficient.

Thanks — I'll loop back when the CSV and DocuSign link are live.
